notes: Parkour maps climbed to a finish at the top are Obby & Platformer, and the answers make each course a compact tower of eight to ten sections, so course-tower with the genre P6 and its P2 for stacked platforms. Rising lava that eliminates on contact is hazard-kill, one of the genuinely contact-lethal cases the genre notes reserve it for; I did not name Survival as a second genre because the lava is a pacing hazard on an obby rather than a resource-and-shelter loop, and hazard-kill already expresses it from Obby's own table. Three selectable courses are three alternative maps that cannot share one surface, so P4 sits on top of the shape's route, and it is worth flagging that P4 is not shipping yet; the map-select area is social-hub and the jump from it into the chosen course is teleporter-link. Deciding without a user, the clear finish at each summit is winner-zone, and I assumed the courses are alternatives picked from one lobby rather than a progression that unlocks in order.
